data.name_en: Big Size Probiotic Coconut Yogurt - Plain Flavor
data.description_en:
Product type: Ready-to-eat refrigerated food ❄️
Net weight: 230g / 500g ⚖️
Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

Clean. Unsweetened. Fermented.

This is natural coconut yogurt, made without shortcuts.

Fermented coconut milk delivers a texture that sits right between creamy and set, with a light coconut aroma and a clean, balanced tang.

No sugar. No flavoring tricks. Just fermentation doing its thing.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE IT 🌾

Neutral enough to go sweet or savory.

Fresh tang from fermentation, not additives.

Works as yogurt — and doubles as a dairy-free sour cream.

INGREDIENTS 🌱

Coconut milk, natural starch, probiotics

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: Coconut
May contain traces of: Soy, Nuts, Gluten

HOW TO EAT 🍽️

Enjoy straight from the spoon.

Mix with maple syrup, fruit, granola, or jam.

Also works well as a dairy-free sour cream for tacos, burritos, and Mexican-style dishes.

STORAGE & SHELF LIFE ❄️

Storage: Keep refrigerated at 0–4°C at all times
Shelf life: See packaging

NUTRITION (PER 100G) 🧮

Energy 190kcal
Fat 18.5g
Carbohydrate 4.9g
Protein 1.6g

INTENDED USE / NOTES 📌

Plant-based fermented product 🌿
Unsweetened, clean-flavored coconut yogurt
data.description_cn:
产品类型：即食冷藏食品 ❄️
净含量：230g / 500g ⚖️
产地：中国广州 🌍

产品描述 🧾

干净、不加糖、真实发酵。

这是一款不走捷径的椰子酸奶。

发酵椰奶形成介于顺滑与凝固之间的质地，椰香轻柔，酸度干净平衡。

没有甜味修饰，只有发酵本身的风味。

为什么人们会选它 🌾

甜咸皆宜，适配度极高。

酸味来自发酵，而不是添加物。

既是酸奶，也可以当作植物版酸奶油使用。

配料表 🌱

椰奶、天然淀粉、益生菌

致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：椰子
可能含有微量：大豆、坚果、麸质

食用方式 🍽️

可直接食用。

搭配枫糖浆、水果、格兰诺拉或果酱。

也非常适合作为墨西哥料理中的植物性酸奶油。

贮存与保质期 ❄️

贮存条件：全程 0–4°C 冷藏保存
保质期：见包装标示

营养信息（每 100g）🧮

能量 190kcal
脂肪 18.5g
碳水化合物 4.9g
蛋白质 1.6g

食用提示 📌

纯植物性发酵产品 🌿
无糖椰子酸奶，风味自然
